name: ABX Innovative Packaging Solutions
old_description: We’re interested in what you have to say. Reach out to learn how we can help
about:
ABX Innovative Packaging Solutions is a flexible packaging manufacturer headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, with manufacturing facilities across the United States including sites in Rhinelander, Wisconsin; Columbus, Georgia; Homer, Louisiana; Macedon, New York; Milwaukee and Pewaukee, Wisconsin; and Schaumburg, Illinois. The company operates nine facilities and employs approximately nine hundred people.

The company produces flexible packaging through a fully integrated process that spans film extrusion, converting, pouching, bagging, printing, and laminating. Its extrusion lines produce coextruded cast and blown films up to 11 layers with thickness capabilities from 1 to 13 mil, using specialty resin blends such as nylon, polypropylene, EVOH, ionomers, and metallocene. Converting operations include stand‑up pouches, rollstock, and a fleet of more than 45 bag machines, while printing is handled on wide‑web W&H flexographic presses with AVT registration. In‑house design consulting, structural testing, and analytical labs support development from concept to commercialization.

ABX serves customers in consumer, healthcare, industrial, and specialty markets, with specific applications in food, personal care, and medical packaging. Its client base includes brands seeking high‑barrier, breathable, or sustainable film structures for products ranging from individual portions to large‑format industrial bags.

The company emphasizes a one‑stop‑shop model from resin to finished package, backed by third‑party quality audits and certifications. It highlights its status as the first plant to earn FTA FIRST certification for wide‑web printers, along with ISO 9001:2015, AIB Superior Rating, HACCP procedures, and FDA‑approved materials as differentiators that support safety, consistency, and regulatory compliance.
